connector.name: Animica
connector.registryDescription: OpenAI-compatible AI inference, code, embeddings & agent tools for bots - and mine ANM.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.animica.org over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package animica-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the animicaorg account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ANIMICA_API_KEY
env.description: Animica API key (anm_live_...). Optional — without it the server auto-provisions a free trial key on first use. Get one at https://pool.animica.org
